decision_notes: National legislature/chamber identity cross-checked against the institution, Wikidata and the primary IPU profile where accessible. This is separate from media and rights evidence. Primary evidence: https://data.ipu.org/parliament/GY/GY-LC01/

The official Parliament site designates this channel. The fifth sitting of the thirteenth Parliament, labelled 2026, plays beyond its black opening. Youth debating competitions in the same listing are not counted as legislative sittings. Footer copyright/disclaimer links lead to committee-business content rather than a usable media licence.

Source conditions: The reviewed official viewing pages designate public access, but no independent audiovisual reuse grant was established. Institutional ownership and working platform playback are not permission to extract, embed or redistribute media.
Catalogue, flags, localized country/jurisdiction search, map and planned schedule-source links reconciled. Link-out only; no HLS or implemented EPG promotion.
